tagline: A global leader in life sciences, diagnostics and applied markets
hero_kpi_rationale: This segment is the primary growth driver for Agilent, contributing 11% growth in 2025, driven by the BIOVECTRA acquisition and demand for molecular and clinical solutions, making it the central strategic lever.
company_description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. provides application focused solutions to the life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, Agilent CrossLab, and Applied Markets. The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets segment offers liquid chromatography systems and components; and liquid chromatography mass spectrometry systems. This segment is also involved in the genomics, contract development and manufacturing organization, pathology, companion diagnostics, and biomolecular analysis businesses. The Agilent CrossLab segment provides various services, including repairs, parts, maintenance, installations, training, compliance support, software as a service, asset management, consulting, and other custom services. This segment also offers consumables, including gas chromatography and liquid chromatography columns, sample preparation products, custom chemistries, and various laboratory supplies; software and informatics solutions comprising software for instrument control, data acquisition, data analysis, secure storage of results, and laboratory information and workflow management; and OpenLab l

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company in a year from sales of products and services.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by 7% in 2025 to $6.948 billion, following a 5% decline in 2024. Growth was driven by all segments and regions, with a positive contribution from the BIOVECTRA acquisition.
kpis.signal: Strong 7% growth in 2025 after a 5% decline in 2024.

kpis.name: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from instruments, reagents, and services for biomedical research and diagnostics.
kpis.description: This segment, newly formed in November 2024, combines diagnostics, genomics, and liquid chromatography. It achieved 11% growth in 2025, driven by demand for clinical and molecular solutions.
kpis.signal: High-growth segment (+11%), amplified by the BIOVECTRA acquisition contributing approximately 5 percentage points of growth.

kpis.name: Agilent CrossLab Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from consumables, services, software, and laboratory automation.
kpis.description: The CrossLab segment, which includes services, consumables, and software, grew 6% in 2025, after +3% in 2024, reflecting stable demand for maintenance and automation solutions.
kpis.signal: Steady growth in services and consumables, attractive recurring revenue model.

kpis.name: Applied Markets Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from instruments used in substance analysis across industry and research.
kpis.description: This segment, impacted in 2024 by reduced customer capex spending, rebounded slightly in 2025 with +1%, despite an unfavorable currency impact.
kpis.signal: Modest recovery after a 7% decline in 2024.

kpis.description: Net income reached $1.303 billion in 2025, up from $1.289 billion in 2024, supported by tax benefits.

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policies
risks.summary: Changes in U.S. and global tariffs increased Agilent's costs in the second half of 2025. The company expects to mitigate this impact in 2026 through supply chain optimization and price adjustments.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned in MD&A (middle of report), moderate language ('increased risk and uncertainty') but acknowledges material impact in H2 2025. Trend: increased (new U.S. measures in H2 2025). Macro-economic category: standard weight.

risks.title: Volatility in Customer Equipment Spending
risks.summary: Pharmaceutical and laboratory customers reduced capital investments in equipment, causing an 11% decline in Life Sciences segment revenue in 2024. This pressure persists and affects business visibility.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in MD&A (middle), direct language ('pressures on our customers' capital expenditure spending'). Trend: stable but persistent (2024 and 2023). Competition/market category: standard weight.

risks.title: Exposure to Foreign Exchange Fluctuations
risks.summary: Agilent operates globally with revenues in foreign currencies. Although the net impact was neutral in 2025, exchange rate fluctuations remain a potential source of earnings volatility.
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in forward-looking statements (beginning), cautious language ('hedging programs and other actions to offset'). Trend: stable (neutral impact in 2025). Macro category: standard weight.

risks.title: Ongoing Litigation and Claims
risks.summary: Agilent is involved in routine legal proceedings (intellectual property, commercial, environmental, employment). Management states that no current matter is expected to have a material financial impact.
risks.score_rationale: Risk in Item 3 (standard legal section), reassuring language ('no matters pending... probable and reasonably possible of having a material impact'). Trend: stable. Litigation category: standard weight but mitigated by absence of declared materiality.

risks.title: Dependence on Acquisitions for Growth
risks.summary: Agilent partially relies on acquisitions for growth (BIOVECTRA contributed 2-5% growth in 2025). The integration and performance of these acquisitions are critical to achieving growth targets.
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in MD&A (middle), BIOVECTRA contributed 2-5% growth in 2025. Neutral language ('integration, effects and timing of our acquisitions'). Trend: stable (ongoing strategy). Technology/growth category: standard weight.

risks.title: Restructuring and Cost Optimization
risks.summary: Agilent is implementing restructuring and cost optimization programs to maintain margins amid pricing and inflationary pressures. The success of these initiatives is essential for profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Risk in forward-looking statements (beginning), neutral language ('expense reduction and other results from our restructuring programs'). Trend: stable (ongoing initiatives). Industrial category: standard weight.
